name: SMART Action Roadmap
deliverable: Time-phased mapping of milestones adhering to SMART validation criteria

steps.text: Lay the goal out as milestones in order, each a result the team can see rather than a phase.
Test every milestone against specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound, then rewrite.
Calendar each milestone and name its first step.

failure: Milestones that pass the acronym but not the calendar: none has an owner, a date, or a number.
intervention: Take the weakest one and ask for the date, number, and person; without all three, it is a wish.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: There's a S.M.A.R.T. way to write management's goals and objectives
